scope: two actual fast processes on one isolated data copy, commit v2 state only after validated original output, restart and identical-frame replay
gapRationale: 60s is the existing minimum evidence interval, not a tuned investment parameter; wait until first frame completion+60s before starting second process
inputChain: pin one main commit for initial data and histories; second cycle must use first validated isolated outputs, never refetch main between cycles
stateCommit: temporary sibling file plus rename after full old-output validation; SHA256 expected-previous check; single writer in one concurrency job, not a distributed CAS or power-loss durability proof
retry: a separate process reloads committed first state and replays exact first frame without browser; full state and file hash must remain unchanged
restart: second actual fast is a new Node process, receipt sequence2, loads committed adapter state1; compare frozen initial fields of surviving rows
history: production legacy not imported or relabeled; existing old ledger advances only inside temporary normal-fast output
sources: reuse insertion-only reviewed 15I capture points, actual cookie/wall/monotonic receipts; no individual card requests
checks: v2/adapter controls and local state faults before live
old publication parity for both cycles
exact replay idempotence after persisted restart
independent sequential replay of both captured frames
exclusions: investment efficacy or full machine-crash claim
